The structure of Cs₂NaS₂ is cubic, space group F-43m (No. 216), with a 24-atom unit cell (Cs₈Na₄S₈) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cs and Na each coordinated by eight S neighbors, while S adopts a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement with eight geometric neighbors (4 Cs, 4 Na), all at about 3.57 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among Cs-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Cs- and Na-centered polyhedra.
